charts.name: gateway-access
charts.description: Routes clusters, Optimize, and management planes through a Gateway of the Gateway API.

charts.name: rustfs
charts.description: Creates a RustFS bucket and an access key for the backups of each cluster.

charts.name: aws
charts.description: Gives each cluster on AWS an IAM role, a KMS key, encrypted EBS volumes, an S3 bucket, and an IAM role for its Connectors. The command turns on all five controllers. Remove the --set of each controller that you do not need.
charts.installCommand: helm install aws oci://ghcr.io/konsole-is/camunda-operator-plugins/charts/aws --version 0.1.0 --namespace camunda-operator-plugins --create-namespace --set identity.enabled=true --set connectorsRole.enabled=true --set kms.enabled=true --set ebs.enabled=true --set s3.enabled=true
